basic_details.job_title: Samagra Shiksha Karnataka Academic Resource Person Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Samagra Shiksha Karnataka has announced 4 vacancies for the Academic Resource Person for Mental Health post on a contract basis. Candidates can apply offline by submitting the prescribed application in person or via registered post to the Samagra Shiksha Karnataka Office, Room No. 36, Zilla Panchayat Bhavan, Navanagar, Bagalkot on or before 23 October 2026 at 5:00 PM. Applicants must possess a Post Graduation in Psychology, Clinical Psychology, Counseling Psychology or Child Development with at least 1 year experience, along with knowledge of Kannada, English and basic computer operations incl

age_limit.details: The age limit for applicants is 26 years to 50 years . Age relaxation is applicable as per the rules with a relaxation up to 26 years to 50 years from the specified age limit criteria mentioned in the notification.

post_wise_qualification.post_name: Academic Resource Person for Mental Health

qualification.details: Must possess a Post Graduation degree in Psychology, Clinical Psychology, Counseling Psychology, or Child Development. Must have at least 1 year of relevant experience in mental health fields. Must possess knowledge of Kannada and English languages. Must possess basic computer operations knowledge including typing. | The age limit for applicants is 26 years to 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per the rules with a relaxation up to 26 years to 50 years from the specified age limit criteria mentioned in the notification.

selection_process: Selection for the Academic Resource Person for Mental Health position will be made on a temporary contract basis through application scrutiny and merit or direct recruitment at the block level.
important_instructions: Applications must reach the designated office on or before 23.10.2026 by 5:00 PM. Late submissions or applications sent through unapproved modes will be summarily rejected. Applicants must ensure they fulfill all prescribed educational, experience, and age criteria before applying. The engagement is strictly temporary on a contract basis up to February 27. A total of 04 block-level positions are distributed across block centres in Bagalkot district.
